## 1. Core Gameplay — Mathematical Model

**Arena & coordinate frame.** World units are meters on an XZ-ish plane rendered in XY (camera looks down −Z). Arena half-width `W = 9`, play band `y ∈ [−4, +5]`. Player locked to `y = −3.2`. All motion is analytic (no physics lib); positions integrate as `p += v·dt` with `dt` already timescale-dilated by the global clock.

**Formation kinematics.** The 11×5 grid (classic count, 55 units) is a rigid body:
- State: anchor `A = (ax, ay)`, direction `d ∈ {+1,−1}`, phase `φ`.
- Each step advances `Δx = d · stepSize`; when any live cell would cross `|x| > W − margin`, the formation drops `dropAmount` and flips `d`.
- **Speed law (smooth AAA curve):** `speedMult = lerp(0.55, 2.6, 1 − alive/total)` — as the grid thins it accelerates continuously (classic used discrete tiers; we interpolate for a fairer ramp). Step interval `T = baseStep / speedMult`.
- **Stomp animation:** two-frame silhouette swap driven by `φ`, synced to each step so the "march" reads.

**Firing model.** Each column's lowest live cell is a candidate. Fire probability per formation-step scales with descent and thinning: `p = clamp(0.12 + 0.5·(1 − alive/total) + 0.3·descent, 0.12, 0.8)`. Bombs integrate `v_y = −bombSpeed`, constant (no gravity — it's space).

**Player dynamics.** Acceleration-based for feel: `a = inputAxis · accel`; `v += a·dt; v *= exp(−friction·dt)` (frame-rate independent damping); `x = clamp(x, −W+1, W−1)`. Fire is edge-triggered with cooldown `cd`, max `maxBullets` live.

**Collision (hand-written).** All tests are analytic circle/point vs AABB in 2D:
- Bullet↔invader: point-in-circle (`dist² < r²`).
- Bomb↔player, bomb↔shield: same, plus shield cell-grid erosion (below).
- **Shield bunkers** modeled as a `cols×rows` grid of health cells. A hit at `(x,y)` erodes a radius-blast: every cell whose center is within `blastR` loses `1 + falloff`; dead cells stop rendering and stop blocking. This is the destructible-bunker math, fully procedural.
- **UFO:** spawns on a Poisson-ish timer, crosses top at constant `v`, high-value; collision = circle test.

**Win/Loss.** Loss: any bomb reaches player hull (lives 0) or formation descends to shield line. Win: clear the wave → next wave (harder). Game-over screen with score/best.

## 2. Modern Enhancements — 18 AAA Upgrades (exact Three.js implementations)

| # | Upgrade | Exact implementation |
|---|---------|----------------------|
| 1 | **PBR voxel hulls** | Each species = boolean pixel-map → merged `BoxGeometry` cluster via `BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries`; one shared geometry per species (3 total), `MeshStandardMaterial{metalness:0.6, roughness:0.35}` + emissive core inset. All 55 invaders share 3 geos/4 mats → near-zero GPU churn. |
| 2 | **Neon bloom** | `UnrealBloomPass(strength≈1.0, radius≈0.55, threshold≈0.82)` — only emissive cores/bullets/shields exceed threshold; base PBR stays clean (no white-out). |
| 3 | **Trauma camera shake** | `CameraShake.addTrauma(v)` where `v = clamp(impactSpeed·mass·k)`, decay `trauma *= exp(−decayRate·dt)`, offset `= trauma²·maxOffset` with per-frame jitter; applied last to camera. |
| 4 | **Hit-stop** | `HitStop.freeze(ms, strength)` sets global timescale target (e.g. 0.12 for 90 ms), eases back to 1.0; heavier impact takes max-remaining precedence. Every system reads the same scalar → coherent slow-mo. |
| 5 | **Particle bursts** | Single `THREE.InstancedMesh` cap **500**; CPU struct pool; presets (sparks/explosion/thruster); priority-culled when over budget; respects timescale. |
| 6 | **Shockwave rings** | Pooled emissive `RingGeometry` meshes, radius expand + opacity fade on every kill/UFO hit. |
| 7 | **Motion trails** | Pooled fading ribbon segments on bullets/bombs/fast movers; auto-culled below speed threshold; first reduced by perf guard. |
| 8 | **Floating score text** | DOM chips projected via `camera.project` each frame, depth-scaled, glassmorphism-styled; capped ~12 live. |
| 9 | **Parallax starfield** | Two/three layered `THREE.Points` (additive, size-attenuated) at different Z for depth + slow drift. |
| 10 | **Neon arena floor** | Procedural `CanvasTexture` grid as `map`+`emissiveMap`, `FogExp2` for depth, glowing boundary rails. |
| 11 | **Destructible bunkers** | Cell-grid erosion (see §1); cells are instanced emissive quads that fade out on damage. |
| 12 | **UFO mystery ship** | Distinct emissive hull + warning shimmer; random 50–1000 pts. |
| 13 | **Procedural audio** | WebAudio: iconic 4-note invader stomp bassline, laser zap (sawtooth pitch-drop), explosion (filtered noise sweep), UFO warble — all synthesized, zero files. |
| 14 | **Music sequencer** | Step-sequenced chiptune; tempo/intensity rise with wave + descent. |
| 15 | **Wave/difficulty curve** | Faster steps, higher fire prob, new species per wave; combo multiplier. |
| 16 | **Combo scoring** | Kills within `comboWindow` build ×2…×8 multiplier → floating text + HUD. |
| 17 | **Power-ups** | Pooled drops: rapid-fire, spread-shot, shield bubble, slow-mo — distinct emissive icons, timed effects on player. |
| 18 | **Perf guard** | FPS monitor; below threshold reduce particle cap / drop trails before dropping frame rate. |

## 3. Graphics Pipeline & Procedural Math

- **Renderer:** `WebGLRenderer{antialias:true}`, `outputColorSpace = SRGBColorSpace`, `ACESFilmicToneMapping`, exposure ≈1.05.
- **Composer chain:** `RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass → OutputPass` (correct sRGB handoff on three 0.160). Per-game `setBloom()` hook.
- **Lighting:** low ambient + directional key + two neon point lights for PBR interest; emissives carry the glow.
- **Fog:** subtle `FogExp2` for background depth.

**Procedural generation math:**
- *Invader geometry:* classic 11×8 sprite bitmaps → filled cells become unit boxes, merged into one `BufferGeometry`; an inset smaller box per "core" cell gets the emissive material (two-material group). Fully code-generated.
- *Grid floor texture:* Canvas 2D — dark base, neon grid lines + radial glow; exported as `THREE.CanvasTexture` with correct color space.
- *Starfield:* N random points in a Z-volume, per-point size/alpha via attributes, additive blending.

---

## 4. VFX Implementation — Priority Logic

Precedence table (highest → lowest):

1. **Hit-stop** owns *time*. It dilates the global timescale; all other systems read that same scalar so they slow together. A new heavier hit takes max-remaining precedence over a lighter one. It composes with (does not cancel) camera shake — different domains.
2. **Camera shake** accumulates trauma from every impact source, decays exponentially, and is applied *last* to the camera each frame after positions settle. Scales by `impactSpeed·mass`.
3. **Particles** enforce the centralized 500 cap; over-budget culls lowest-priority first: player-death > UFO-kill > invader-kill > shield-hit. Bursts respect timescale (slow during hit-stop for impact weight).
4. **Shockwave rings** — pooled, spawn on death/UFO, expand+fade, respect timescale.
5. **Motion trails** — continuous, attached to fast movers; auto-culled below speed threshold; first thing the perf guard drops.
6. **Floating text** — DOM, projected per frame, capped ~12 live, oldest fades out.

Timescale flow: `HitStop` → global scalar in `Engine.clock` → consumed by particles/trails/audio-sequencer/formation/player identically, so a hit-stop reads as one coherent freeze across the whole scene.

package.json          # pinned three@0.160.1, vite@5.4.8 · "type":"module"

| `core/InputController.js` | `class InputController { update(), snapshot: {axes:{x}, buttons:{fire,pause,primary}, edge:{fire} , gamepadActive }` |
| `core/ObjectPool.js` | `class ObjectPool { prewarm(n), acquire(), release(obj), activeCount, capacity }` |
| `math/MathUtils.js` | `clamp, lerp, damp, randRange, TAU, angleWrap` |
| `math/Noise.js` | `simplex2(x,y), fbm(x,y,oct)` |
| `vfx/CameraShake.js` | `class CameraShake { addTrauma(v), update(dt), apply(camera) }` |
| `vfx/HitStop.js` | `class HitStop { freeze(ms,strength), update(dt), timescale }` |
| `vfx/ParticleManager.js` | `class ParticleManager { burst(preset,pos,opts), update(dt,timescale), setCap(n) }` (InstancedMesh, 500 cap) |
| `vfx/ShockwaveRings.js` | `class ShockwaveRings { spawn(pos,color,scale), update(dt) }` |

| `postfx/ComposerSetup.js` | `setupComposer(renderer,camera,scene) → {composer,setBloom(w,h,s,r,t),dispose}` |
| `procedural/TextureFactory.js` | `gridFloor(), glowSprite(), starfield()` (CanvasTexture) |
| `procedural/GeometryFactory.js` | `invaderHull(speciesMap)`, shared ring/hull geos, cache + dispose |

**`Space_Invaders/`:**
```
plan.md                 # this document (persisted at implementation start)
config.js               # all tuning constants: speeds, caps, scoring, bloom, wave curve
index.js                # BOOT → wires Engine/Input/UI/VFX/Audio → new Game() → engine.start()
Game.js                 # orchestrator + state machine (MENU/PLAYING⇄PAUSED/GAME_OVER)
entities/PlayerShip.js  # accel/friction motion, fire cooldown, power-up state; pooled bullets
entities/Invader.js     # species hull, stomp anim, alive/dead; shared geo/mat via GeometryFactory
entities/Bullet.js      # player shot + bomb (shared geometry, distinct materials) — pooled
entities/UFO.js         # mystery ship, bonus scoring
entities/ShieldBunker.js# cell-grid erosion model + instanced emissive cells
entities/PowerUp.js     # rapid/spread/shield/slowmo drops — pooled
systems/CollisionSystem.js   # hand-written circle/AABB tests; routes hits to VFX/scoring
systems/FormationController.js# block kinematics, stomp sync, firing probability (§1)
systems/WaveManager.js       # wave progression, difficulty curve, species unlock
systems/ScoringSystem.js     # base + combo multiplier, best-score persistence (localStorage)
```

**Import graph (one-way; shared never imports from a game):**
- `index.js` → `Engine, InputController, GlassUI, ComposerSetup, AudioEngine, MusicSequencer, CameraShake, HitStop, ParticleManager, ShockwaveRings, MotionTrails, FloatingText, Game, config`
- `Game.js` → all `entities/*`, all `systems/*`, shared vfx/audio/pool/math
- `entities/*` → `ObjectPool, MathUtils, GeometryFactory, TextureFactory, three` (+ `MeshStandardMaterial`)
- `systems/CollisionSystem.js` → entities + `ParticleManager, ShockwaveRings, HitStop, CameraShake, FloatingText, ScoringSystem`
- `systems/FormationController.js` → `Invader, Bullet, MathUtils, config`

**Memory ownership:** every GPU allocation registers with `Engine`'s disposable registry; teardown walks it and calls `.dispose()` on each geometry/material/texture exactly once. Shared factories cache geos/textures (created once); hot paths acquire/release from pools — never `new` in the update loop. Particles are one 500-cap `InstancedMesh`; invaders share 3 geometries / ~4 materials across all 55 units.

---

**State machine:** `BOOT → MENU → PLAYING ⇄ PAUSED → GAME_OVER → (restart) PLAYING`, with wave transitions inside `PLAYING`.
